calculation.description: Contrarian cross-asset signal combining a dominant one-day volatility-normalized shock with a smaller five-day anchor. Positive values indicate expected rebound after negative standardized returns. Uses only information through the completed date.

validation.regime_notes: Daily IC remained positive in 2020-2022 (0.054715; 763 dates), 2023-2024 (0.040357; 516 dates), and 2025-2027 (0.038366; 574 dates). Small 15-asset universe warrants conservative interpretation; daily gate passed with broad coverage, while predictive decay is rapid beyond one day.
